title: Isharani Baruah Reaches Vietnam Open Final
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Isharani Baruah has advanced to her first BWF Tour final of the season at the Vietnam Open.
summary: Isharani Baruah defeated Rakshitha 21-10, 21-18 in 39 minutes to secure her spot in the Vietnam Open 2026 final, marking a significant achievement for the Indian player.

title: H.S. Prannoy Aims for First World Tour Final at Vietnam Open Semis
indian_angle: Top Indian men's singles player H.S. Prannoy is set to compete in the Vietnam Open semifinal, with a chance to reach his first World Tour final this season.
summary: H.S. Prannoy will face Teh Jia Heng Jason in the Vietnam Open semifinal, a crucial match as he looks to break his semifinal jinx and reach a BWF World Tour final.

title: Tanvi Sharma Faces Vitidsarn in Vietnam Open Semifinal Clash
indian_angle: Young Indian talent Tanvi Sharma is preparing for her Vietnam Open semifinal match against Sarunrak Vitidsarn, marking her first senior-level encounter against the opponent.
summary: Tanvi Sharma is scheduled to play Sarunrak Vitidsarn in the Vietnam Open semifinal, a significant challenge and opportunity for the Indian shuttler in her senior circuit debut against this opponent.

title: BAI Organizes Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: Badminton Association of India is conducting an advanced Level-1 coaches course in two Indian cities to enhance coaching standards domestically.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is holding a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at its National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Final Selection Trials for BWF World Junior Championships 2026 Announced
indian_angle: The list of qualified Indian players for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has been released, shaping India's future talent.
summary: BAI has released the player eligibility criteria and the list of qualified players for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Indian Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships
indian_angle: A coaching camp for the Indian U17 & U15 junior teams is underway in Guwahati, preparing young players for the upcoming Badminton Asia Junior Championships.
summary: The Indian Team Coaching Camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.
